object.body:
Hello,

The ${PRODUCT_NAME} system has created an account for ${username} on the ${source} system. Here are the details about this account:

User Name: ${accountUserName}

Access:
#foreach ($access in $accountAccess)

  • $access

    • #end

    If you have any questions, contact your administrator.

    Thanks,
    The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
object.description: Sent to a user when an account is created on a source for them.
object.name: New Account Provisioned
object.subject: ${source} - Account Created For ${username}
